original.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io newly requires the field status.artifact.digest (computed diff between the flux v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles), and Bucket objects that omit the field are rejected.

decision.reason: The computed diff between the v2.6.4 install bundle [ev-782bc47d120d] and the v2.7.0 install bundle [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] shows that `status.artifact.digest` is newly required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of buckets. The deterministic validators confirmed both the subject and the now-required change from those artifacts. Setting version=v1 is right because the change is stated for the v1 schema only. Known fact vf-fb79bb6ccebd records the same subject and change, but the release is not stated for either one, so I'm not treating this item as a duplicate.
